title: Components V2 Edit Compatibility
summary: Makes Components V2 message refreshes safe for both historical embeds and already-modernized cards
changes: Migrates historical embed messages in two safe edits before enabling Discord's Components V2 flag
Stops refresh payloads from mixing forbidden content or embed fields with Components V2 containers
Preserves card text and structure when request, weekly or support workflows only replace or disable buttons
Covers classic-to-V2 refreshes, existing V2 edits and controls-only updates with regression tests
